concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished flat mobile app screen proposal for Halovat Qibla, portrait 9:19.5.
IMPORTANT CORRECTION: The user wants a SMALL THIRD-PERSON 3D PERSON HOLDING A PHONE INSIDE THE APP'S MINI MAP. Do NOT show a real hand holding a physical phone, no external phone frame or lifestyle photo. The output is solely the app screen.
Reference image 1 gives ivory/emerald app UI palette and hierarchy, NOT its empty photoreal scene. Reference image 2 is exact Home 3D mosque artwork for nearby row.
Core central visual: one large rounded 3D mini-map occupying about 45% screen height. View it from an oblique third-person camera above and behind a miniature HUMAN AVATAR. Avatar stands at lower-center on a simple pale mint/ivory ground map, seen clearly from behind in three-quarter view, full body, wearing neutral cream shirt and dark trousers, HOLDING A SMALL SMARTPHONE in front with both hands; the phone must be visible as part of pose. Person is about 22% map height, recognizably a small person, not a phone marker. Forward direction and a very short emerald arrow/compact heading wedge next to feet indicate rotation. Only one avatar, no ghost duplicates. Around feet is a fine heading ring whose orientation matches avatar and phone; this communicates that the person rotates with the real device heading.
Further ahead in upper-right of this same map place a realistic miniature 3D closed Kaaba cuboid, black fabric with gold band and door, fixed at Qibla bearing. Camera framing must show BOTH full avatar and full Kaaba, comfortably separated. A subtle short dashed direction cue near the avatar may aim toward Kaaba; no long sweeping arrow. Mini-map has very few quiet street/grid shapes and no place-label noise. Treat this as a calm navigational 3D scene, like a refined miniature map, not real camera AR or a photograph of Mecca. Friendly dimensional rendering, soft shadows, controlled perspective, elevated but not extreme top-down.
Top modest native sans title 'Qibla'; slim location 'Toshkent' and 'GPS · ±17 m'.
Below map native SF Pro/system sans '52°' and 'O‘ngga buring'. Small 'Qibla 240° · Telefon 188°'. Minimal outlined 'Qayta sozlash' action.
Nearby bottom row 'Yaqin masjidlar' with exact supplied 3D mosque asset at left and a chevron right, no outline mosque icon.
Always visible native bottom tabs: 'Bosh sahifa', 'Namozlar', 'Tasbeh', 'Qibla', 'Profil'; Qibla selected.
Visual style matches app: warm ivory #FAF9F5, emerald #064E3B, mint #BFF1DB, restrained gold on Kaaba, native system sans fonts throughout, no serif, no glass blobs, no decorative typography, no giant title.
No external hands/phone device, no large human outside map, no floating isolated phone instead of avatar, no multiple avatars, no long arrows, no watermark, no multi-panel collage. Deliver single full flat screen.

Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a second distinct high-fidelity Qibla app screen proposal, portrait 9:19.5, ONLY flat app UI.
Core user requirement: INSIDE THE APP is a 3D MINI MAP with a SMALL PERSON HOLDING A PHONE seen in THIRD PERSON. Rotating the real phone rotates this avatar's heading; Kaaba is a separate 3D fixed target. This is NOT a photo of a real person holding a phone. No external handset mockup, no hand outside UI.
Input 1: app UI reference for sans-serif fonts, warm ivory and emerald palette, bottom actions/nav. Input 2: actual 3D mosque Home asset to use on nearby-mosques button.
Variant: an open isometric mini-map scene blending into ivory page rather than a heavy framed card. Camera above and behind avatar at a gentle 35-degree downward angle. A small full-body 3D person at lower-left/center in soft cream top, dark trousers, both hands visibly holding a smartphone at chest height. Human face not central, see mainly back and right shoulder. Person occupies about 24% scene height, PHONE IN THE AVATAR'S HANDS clearly visible. Feet centered on a thin small emerald compass heading disc; disc and avatar turn together. Short emerald chevron on the disc shows where avatar looks. No long arrow, no curving path. Upper-right in same map is a 3D miniature black-and-gold Kaaba model at a fixed position. A very subtle target bearing line/ray on the map relates the avatar to the Kaaba. Mini-map has only a few pale ground tile lines and minimal low-relief blocks; keep navigation simple with no buildings competing with Kaaba. Both objects completely visible. The ground scene is around 43% of screen height and retains ample white space. This should feel like elegant interactive 3D navigation from third-person game camera, not a tabletop display photographed from outside app.
UI: small centered 'Qibla' header; location line 'Toshkent' and 'GPS · ±17 m'. Native iOS SF Pro/system sans throughout. Beneath scene horizontal navigation instruction: '52°' left and 'O‘ngga buring' right, then 'Qibla 240° · Telefon 188°'. Clean outlined 'Qayta sozlash' button. Nearby-mosques compact card at bottom 'Yaqin masjidlar', using supplied 3D ivory mosque with green dome/minaret at left, chevron right.
Five native bottom tabs always visible: 'Bosh sahifa', 'Namozlar', 'Tasbeh', 'Qibla', 'Profil', Qibla active.
Warm ivory #FAF9F5, evergreen #064E3B, soft mint, restrained natural lighting and refined soft 3D shadows. Calm native app typography, readable text.
Avoid serif, oversized heading, real hands surrounding screen, external physical phone, missing avatar, avatar without phone, multiple people, multiple Kaabas, long directional arrows, generic metric dashboards, extra panels, watermark. One single flat screen.

refinement: Edit the supplied Qibla app mockup with ONE targeted correction only: the Kaaba model in the upper-right currently has a pale recessed open tray-like top. Replace ONLY that top surface with a fully closed flat dark charcoal/black roof plane with subtle realistic seams, flush within the black cuboid. Kaaba must be a closed solid building, no open cavity, no white floor visible on top. Preserve every other part exactly: third-person miniature man holding phone, position/pose, short heading arrow, map floor perspective, UI typography/text/layout, nearby 3D mosque, navbar, colors and lighting. Do not redesign or move anything. Single flat app screen output.
interactionIntent: Rotate the miniature phone-holding avatar with actual device heading; keep Kaaba as the Qibla target. Static design proposals only, no runtime implementation.
